provenance.note: E.6.8 names "Long Range Scheiben (B.10.5.7.2 bis B.10.5.7.6)"; Teil B has no such numbers, the Long Range faces are B.11.8.2 to B.11.8.6. 5 sighters and 10 scoring shots in 30 min, or 5 sighters and 15 scoring shots in 45 min as announced (E.6.7); the book gives one shot clause for all classes.
